title: IRGC Navy Public Relations:
text:
IRGC Navy Public Relations:"

"🔹 Over the past 24 hours, three violating oil tankers, while crossing the unauthorized southern route of the Strait of Hormuz, struck mines, exploded, caught fire, and were abandoned on the southern coasts of the Strait of Hormuz."

"🔹 These tankers had turned off all their radar and navigation systems and, ignoring the warnings of the IRGC Navy, were trying to exit through the unauthorized southern route of the Strait of Hormuz when they hit naval mines and exploded."

"🔹 The IRGC Navy announces that the unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz is mined, and that the owners and crews of vessels are responsible for crossing these routes. They should not pay attention to CENTCOM’s illusions in cyberspace."

"🔹 The reality will become clear on the ground. Any provocative action, backed by the support and malice of the terrorist and aggressor US military, that disregards the regulations of this strait will be decisively confronted.
